name: libexpat.wasm
description: Expat XML parser library compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p build && cd build && emcc -O3 -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_expat_get_version","_expat_get_version_info","_expat_parser_create","_expat_parser_create_ns","_expat_parser_free","_expat_parser_reset","_expat_parse","_expat_parse_buffer","_expat_get_buffer","_expat_get_error_code","_expat_error_string","_expat_get_current_line_number","_expat_get_current_column_number","_expat_get_current_byte_index","_expat_set_param_entity_parsing","_expat_set_hash_salt","_expat_set_user_data","_expat_get_user_data","_expat_set_element_handler","_expat_set_character_data_handler","_expat_set_processing_instruction_handler","_expat_set_comment_handler","_expat_set_start_cdata_handler","_expat_set_end_cdata_handler","_expat_set_default_handler","_expat_set_start_namespace_decl_handler","_expat_set_end_namespace_decl_handler","_expat_get_feature_list","_expat_malloc","_expat_free","_expat_parse_string","_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap","HEAPU8","addFunction","removeFunction","UTF8ToString","stringToUTF8"]' -s INITIAL_MEMORY=16MB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=256MB -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s STACK_SIZE=2MB -s ASSERTIONS=0 --closure 1 -flto -DHAVE_EXPAT_CONFIG_H=1 -I../expat/lib -I.. ../src/wasm_module.c ../expat/lib/xmlparse.c ../expat/lib/xmlrole.c ../expat/lib/xmltok.c -o expat.js

author: WASM Ecosystem Contributors
